propositions: A PreToolUse hook on the Bash tool must emit a reminder when grep-family commands (grep, rg, egrep, fgrep) are invoked, surfacing Serena symbol tools as the preferred alternative.

The hook trigger must match grep-family strings literally without pattern classification or path heuristics, and the reminder message must be 2-3 lines, non-blocking, and name both the preferred symbol lookup AND legitimate grep use cases (string literals, line numbers).
The hook must emit JSON with additionalContext but omit permissionDecision to remain informative and non-blocking, never denying the grep call or suppressing permission prompts.

The hook configuration must be added to .claude/settings.json without overwriting story C's env.ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH setting, and the hook logic must be implemented as a tracked, testable script at scripts/hooks/serena_grep_reminder.py.
